text.ko: 업종 내 매우 약함. 약점: 총자산이익률(ROA) -1.2%.
text.en: Very weak within its sector. Weakness: Return on assets -1.2%.

text.en: Weak within its sector. Weakness: Revenue growth, last 12 months 5.8%.

text.en: About average for its sector. Strength: Liabilities to equity 67.1%. Weakness: Intangibles and goodwill share of assets 66.5%.

text.en: About average for its sector. Strength: Price to book 2.62x. Weakness: Price to earnings n/m (negative).

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경이 이 업종에 불리한 편이에요. 주요 요인: 금리 상승 국면 (불리).
text.en: The current economy tends to work against this sector. Main factor: rising rates (hurts).
